name: Cape of Stranglethorn
summary: Booty Bay holds fast as rival crews contest the Cape of Stranglethorn. From Gurubashi Arena to the ocean cliffs, goblins, Bloodsail Buccaneers, ancient jungle trolls, and wildlife struggle for control.

sections.title: Edge of the Continent
sections.body: South of Gurubashi Arena, dense jungle reaches the coast. The Ruins of Jubuwal and the Ruins of Aboraz mark ground the Gurubashi Empire no longer holds. Now predators, murloc encampments, and rival pirate crews fill the beaches, coves, and clearings. They fight over trade routes and buried plunder.

sections.title: Booty Bay and the Buccaneer War
sections.body:
The Blackwater Raiders hold the cape’s greatest power. Baron Revilgaz and Fleet Master Seahorn lead them from Booty Bay, a neutral harbor carved into the southern bay’s cliffs. Steamships link the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor through Ratchet.

Yet goblin control remains precarious. Along the southern shoals and outer islands, the Bloodsail Buccaneers raid supply lines and plot to overthrow Booty Bay and seize the South Seas.

faq.q: What is the difference between Stranglethorn Vale and the Cape of Stranglethorn?
faq.answer: The Cape of Stranglethorn is the southern part of the larger Stranglethorn Vale. It runs from south of Gurubashi Arena to Booty Bay and the coast.

faq.q: Who rules the Cape of Stranglethorn?
faq.answer: No single power controls the entire cape. Baron Revilgaz and the goblin-backed Blackwater Raiders govern Booty Bay and nearby waters. Bloodsail Buccaneers, naga, and troll remnants hold beaches and interior ruins.

faq.q: Can Horde and Alliance both use Booty Bay?
faq.answer: Yes. Booty Bay is an open, neutral port maintained by the Steamwheedle Cartel. Keep your weapons sheathed and the peace within city limits, and both Alliance and Horde travelers can use its docks, vendors, flight master, and auction house.
The Gurubashi Arena is an ancient troll fighting pit near the cape’s northern edge. Combatants gather there to test themselves.

faq.q: How do travelers get between the Cape and Kalimdor?
faq.answer: A goblin-operated steamship regularly sails from Booty Bay to Ratchet, the port town in the Barrens. It is one of the few passenger links across the South Seas.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find privateers, scoundrels, and cutthroats across the cape. Pick pockets, run coastal contraband, or play the Blackwater Raiders against the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
As a cook, you can fish the rich waters of the South Seas and coast. Booty Bay’s fishmongers and harbor cooks sell rare recipes.
